home.intro: Developer, beekeeper, and maker of all sorts. I build thoughtful, accessible things for the web. Away from the keyboard, the curiosity carries on.

work.heading: Software with people in mind.
work.body: Whether I'm working on user experience (UX), developer experience (DevEx), or collaborating with a team, I start with the people involved. I care about accessibility, clarity, and making everyday work easier.

development.heading: From interface to API.
development.body: I'm a full-stack developer at {employer}. I build frontends with Angular and Vue, backends and APIs with .NET/C#, and use Azure as the cloud platform. I enjoy working across the stack and understanding how the pieces fit together.

work.link: More about my work on LinkedIn

sewing.heading: One stitch at a time.
sewing.body: Sewing is one of my favourite ways to make something with my hands. I enjoy working with fabric, figuring out how the pieces fit, and watching an idea take shape, stitch by stitch.

printing.heading: From screen to something solid.
printing.body: I like designing something in 3D, then bringing it into the real world with a printer. Modelling, testing, adjusting, and trying again is part of the fun.

making.heading: Different tools. Same curiosity.
making.body: Knitting, electronics, woodworking, and whatever else catches my interest. I love learning new techniques, tinkering with materials, and figuring out how to make things myself.

beekeeping.heading: A different kind of busy.
beekeeping.body: Some days, I trade the keyboard for time at the hive. Beekeeping is another part of my life, with plenty to learn along the way.

other.heading: Away from the projects.
other.body: A good book, a video game, a board game now and then. I also like having room for things that don't need a plan or a finished result.
